joiners.name: David Weintraub
joiners.note: Entry 2009 as UVA resident (UVA list Sep-2010/Mar-2011, no marker). NIH CC page first lists him Apr-2012 as 'PGY3' (Oct-2011/Jan-2012 captures list only Ho, Mehta); UVA shows 'Weintraub, David(at NIH)' from May-2012. Treated as joining the NIH track at PGY-3 in 2011-12, an internal NIH-UVA track move. Program 113 excludes him from UVA for all years, so there is no UVA-side transfer-out. PGY-7 2015-16; graduated 2016 (training_history th_id 3376; on UVA alumni list, not NIH's).

problems: Joint NIH-UVA track 2010-~2021 entrants (clinical years at UVA); classes from 2021 (McAbee) train with MedStar Georgetown. Most roster evidence after 2014 comes from partner pages (UVA, MedStar) that mark residents '(NIH)'; stored as wayback/live when complete for NIH residents, CC captures as 'other'. NIH's own sites (clinicalcenter GME 2010-16, neuroscience.nih.gov 2019-20, research.ninds.nih.gov 2021-25) are gone; live www.ninds.nih.gov and www.cc.nih.gov return 403 to automated fetches (not bypassed), so 2025-26/2026-27 depend on MedStar+UVA pages. NIH alumni list stops at 2023 (Ampie ~2024, Asuzu ~2025 graduates not listed; only alumni-page grads inserted into training_history: Mehta 2017, Ho 2018, Ksendzovsky 2019, Maggio 2020, Mastorakos 2022, Pomeraniec 2023). Weintraub (grad 2016) not on NIH alumni page. No NIH entrant in 2014 (empty slot visible 2014-15..2020-21, no 2021 graduate) - could hide an unseen 2014 intern who left in PGY-1 2014-15, but the 2014-15 UVA and Apr-2015 CC pages both show no NIH PGY-1.
